name: Our Little World
subtitle: Private baby book for family
privacyPolicyText: Our Little World is a private baby book for parents, guardians, and caregivers. The app may collect account information such as the email address used for one-time-code sign-in; family profile information you add; photos, videos, photo metadata, voice notes, written notes, milestones, letters, and other memories you choose to save; device permission status for Photos, Camera, or Microphone; and purchase or entitlement records needed to manage subscriptions, gifts, and partner codes. This information is used to provide the private family timeline, library, milestones, prompts, letters, invite features, billing support, and account support. We do not sell personal information and do not use a public social feed, likes, or advertising algorithm. Photos and memories are intended for your private family space. For support or privacy requests, contact support@ourlittleworld.me.
